messages:
sre-bot: INCIDENT ALERT - Sev2 - model-quality-regression - paging oncall @dana :rotating_light:

.dana (oncall): taking this. oncall ack — investigating. can someone share which model variant deployed in the last 30m?

mike (serving): saw the deploy to rwd-model/3.2.1-quant at 1816002900. Increasing error reports from our eval checks and external traces showing elevated hallucination rate on medium-length prompts. logs: ```ERROR 2026-03-15T09:10:12Z inference: rerank mismatch threshold_exceeded: 0.24 -> 0.62```

rohit (ml): confirmed — eval harness shows quality delta on prompt-suite A (ROUGE↓, answer factuality failures ↑). Noted sequence-length distribution for impacted queries is 250-600 tokens, which triggers a new attention kernel path in 3.2.1 that we suspect has precision regression after quant changes.

.dana (oncall): summary: user-visible quality regressions for some customers. No total system down but higher error/incorrect responses for generation outputs. Impact: some enterprise customers (IDs: corp-172, retail-55) escalated to support. Priority: mitigate to reduce customer impact.

alice (product-ops): prepping status page draft. proposed status: 
```
Status: Partial degradation of text generation quality for a subset of requests.
Impacted: Hosted inference using rwd-model 3.2.1-quant in us-west1
Timeline: Investigating. Mitigation in progress.
Next update: in 30 minutes or upon rollback completion.
```

.katie-support: do we have copy for customer DMs? they want a short blurb to send to their ops teams.

mike (serving): mitigation options: 1) rollback to rwd-model/3.1.7 (previous verified), 2) pin affected customers to 3.1.7 via routing policy, 3) apply temporary runtime flag to force legacy kernel for >200 tokens (riskier). My vote: rollback the global deploy for hosted until we have a fix. Command to rollback (from deploy bot): ```/deploy rollback rwd-model 3.1.7 --reason "quality regression 3.2.1"```

rohit (ml): agree with rollback. Also recommend immediate pinning for Dedicated customers who request isolation: ```api update-routing --customer corp-172 --model rwd-model:3.1.7```

.dana (oncall): execute rollback now. mike, can you run it? I'll coordinate status updates and support comms.

mike (serving): running rollback... (invoked deploy-bot)

deploy-bot: Rollback started for rwd-model -> target 3.1.7. Job id: 5521. Estimated 6m to full rollout.

.dana (oncall): taking a brief handoff note for next oncall: if rollout stalls, escalate to eng-platform and eng-runtime oncall. i'll update OpsPlaybook entry. @alice please post status page when we have confirmation of rollback completion.

alice (product-ops): drafting status page update and a short customer DM. Customer DM suggestion: 
```
Hi — we detected a drop in generation quality for a subset of requests after a recent model update. We rolled back to the previous model version to restore expected behavior. No action required on your side. We're monitoring and will follow up with a post-mortem.
```

.katie-support: sending that to corp-172 now. will cc product-ops.

mike (serving): rollback completion reported by deploy-bot: ```deploy-bot: Rollback job 5521 completed. rwd-model now at 3.1.7 across hosted clusters.````

.dana (oncall): observed key metric trending back toward baseline on canary traffic. running full regression suite now.

rohit (ml): canary eval results: prompt-suite A metrics: baseline restored within noise for 3.1.7. No obvious perf regressions. recommend we keep 3.1.7 as default while we debug quantization changes in 3.2.1.

alice (product-ops): status page posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1816004321 - short update posted, linking to customer DM template.

.katie-support: confirmed customers notified. a couple asked for ETA for fix. suggested reply: "we're tracking a root-cause; we expect a technical update in 24-48 hours and will provide a timeline in the post-mortem."

.dana (oncall): next steps checklist: 
- [x] rollback complete
- [x] status page & customer DM posted
- [x] canary/regression checks passed
- [ ] assign root-cause to eng-runtime + ml-research (rohit owner)
- [ ] create post-mortem and follow-up comms

mike (serving): creating playbook ticket and tagging eng-runtime: infra ticket #IR-7812. include logs and the failing kernel path.

rohit (ml): taking root-cause. i'll reproduce locally with quant config and run kernel-level tests. will update in 6 hours or sooner.

.dana (oncall): handing off to night oncall @morgan at 1816005600. Morgan, notes in the oncall doc and IR-7812. Escalation path: eng-platform -> eng-runtime -> ml.

mike (serving): leaving a short runbook snippet for Morgan: 
```
If rollback appears incomplete: check deploy job 5521 status, verify cluster tags, and run: /deploy verify rwd-model 3.1.7 --clusters all
If customers experience residual issues, pin per-customer via routing and notify support.
```

.morgan (oncall): (joined thread) ack'ed handoff, will monitor overnight.

alice (product-ops): capturing customer impact summary for post-mortem: "Minor to moderate quality regressions observed for a subset of generation requests after model 3.2.1 deploy. We rolled back to 3.1.7 to restore service quality. A follow-up RCA will be shared."

.dana (oncall): closing incident thread for active mitigation. reopening if we see reappearance. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
